Name: Leak Only
Description: Only runs enough of HLBSP to check for leaks, then stops. Useful for quickly testing map sealing.
Warning: Does not produce a usable BSP.

Name: No Fill
Description: Skips outside filling. Faster, but leaks will not be detected or masked.

Name: No Clip
Description: Skip clipnode generation. Must match the -noclip setting used in HLCSG.

Name: No Opt
Description: Disables automatic removal of unused planes from the output BSP.

Name: No T-Junc
Warning: Debugging option, not for normal use.

Name: Max Node Size
Description: Maximum portal node size. Smaller values BSP the world into more, smaller pieces.

Name: Subdivide
Description: Face subdivide size in units (default 240, min 64, max 512).

Name: Chart
Description: Prints BSP statistics before writing the output.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLBSP as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLBSP as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually overrides the number of CPU threads used.
